conditions.frontal: both eyes separated: interocular >= 22% of the face box
conditions.turned: head rotated away from the camera

notes: Real footage of the registered people, labelled by eye.
Query images are regions of video frames, so images from one block are near-duplicates; the splitter keeps a block whole.

The unknown split holds false face detections, not unregistered people: this footage contains no third person whose face the detector resolves, so the impostor evidence here is weaker than a deployment needs.
